sloka: निर्याणश्रीश्च या ऽस्यासीद्भास्वरा वसुदुर्लभा ।सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः ।। ६.५७.४१ ।।।।
transliteration: niryāṇaśrīśca yā 'syāsīdbhāsvarā vasudurlabhā ।sā nanāśa muhūrtena same ca skhalitā hayāḥ ।। 6.57.41 ।।।।

translations.english: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.
